lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense arrangement of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters distributed in roughly vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. Centroids exhibit high-intensity local maxima with a semi-regular spatial frequency.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid-like pattern where the blobs act as nodes within the vertical linear features.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow transitions on the inferior edge.
